text: Calloway Mutual financed the Garrow Heights housing scheme, according to municipal records released Friday by the Lydesmere Housing Office. The 84-unit development on Briar Lane opened in phases between March and October, with final landscaping completed this week. Project manager Elise Vanner said the bank provided the primary construction loan and later extended repayment terms after material costs rose. The scheme, built by North Quay Developments, includes 52 family homes, 18 senior flats and 14 starter apartments. “Without Calloway Mutual, the financing would not have closed on schedule,” said housing councillor Bren Orswick. Officials said all units were reserved within 11 days of listing, with first residents expected to move in on Monday.
